info.title: PROSPECTIVE Web API
info.description:
REST + WebSocket API for cerebral aneurysm segmentation, detection, morphometry, perforator risk assessment and stent planning.

All linear dimensions are in **millimetres (mm)**. All HU values follow the standard Hounsfield scale.

post.summary: Login and obtain JWT token
post.description:
Authenticates with username + password and returns a signed JWT.

Include the token in subsequent requests as:
`Authorization: Bearer <token>`

Default credentials on first run: **admin / admin123**.

get.description: Returns the profile of the user identified by the Bearer token.

get.summary: Download the current user's profile photo
get.description: Serves the authenticated user's own profile photo (404 if none).

post.summary: Request a new account
post.description: Public self-registration. Creates a **pending** account that an administrator must approve before the user can log in.

get.summary: Download a pending user's profile photo (admin)

get.description: Returns all self-registrations awaiting approval. Admin only.

post.description: Activates the account so the user can log in. Admin only.

schema.title: Response Approve Api Auth Pending  User Id  Approve Post

post.summary: Create a user (admin)
post.description: Admin-only. Creates an **active** account with the full professional profile (same fields as self-registration) plus an explicit role and optional photo/CV. No approval step — the user can log in immediately.

get.description: Small PNG (mid axial slice) rendered when the study was archived.

post.summary: Archive a session's DICOM as a new imaging study of a case
post.description: Copies the DICOM of `session_id` into durable storage as a NEW imaging study of this clinical case and renders its preview, so it survives the session TTL and appears in the gallery. A case can hold several imaging studies (CT + angiography + follow-up), so archiving never overwrites a previous one.

post.summary: Open an archived study in a fresh session
post.description: Materialises the archived DICOM into a new working session, scans its series and activates the best 3-D volume — exactly as a fresh upload would — so the pipeline can start straight away. Returns the same shape as `POST /api/upload`.

post.summary: Upload DICOM files
post.description:
Accepts one or more DICOM files (multipart/form-data). Creates a new processing session, saves files to disk, and returns session_id and the metadata of every DICOM series detected.

Send as `Content-Type: multipart/form-data` with field name `files`.

post.summary: Switch the session's active DICOM series
post.description:
A study often carries several series (localisers, 2-D cines and more than one 3-D acquisition). Upload activates the best 3-D volume, but the clinician may want a different acquisition. This re-points the session at `series_id` and drops the cached volume so MPR/segmentation reload it.

Everything derived from the previous series (mesh, detection, morphometry) becomes stale — the client must reset those steps.

get.description:
Returns the automatically computed lower/upper HU thresholds for the DICOM series loaded in this session, along with the strategy key and a Spanish clinical hint string.

Thresholds are derived from the **actual voxel distribution** (which is what detects DSA subtraction, display-preset windows, etc.). The volume is read from the MPR cache and subsampled, so the call stays fast; if no volume is available yet it falls back to WindowCenter/WindowWidth.

Strategies: `ct_stats`, `ct_wc_ww`, `xa_band_pass`, `xa_wc_ww`, `xa_window_mismatch`, `xa_raw16`, `dsa`, `mr_percentile`, `wc_ww`.

post.summary: Run segmentation pipeline
post.description:
Loads the DICOM volume from disk, applies the requested lower/upper thresholds, and runs the full VTK Marching-Cubes pipeline (smoothing + decimation + normals). Returns the mesh URL (.vtp) ready for vtk.js rendering.

**Processing time:** 5–60 s depending on volume size and smoothing level. Use the WebSocket `/ws/progress/{session_id}` endpoint to stream progress updates.

get.summary: Adaptive starting band from the volume histogram
get.description: Starting band + a robust value range for the sliders, derived from THIS volume's own intensity distribution via the SAME modality-aware logic the segmentation uses (compute_auto_thresholds). One source of truth: the live preview reflects the real result, and non-subtracted 3DRA/CTA start on the bright vasculature (~1%) instead of a generic p94 that grabbed ~6% of tissue.

post.summary: Fast coarse-mesh preview for interactive threshold tuning
post.description: Runs a downsampled marching-cubes pass (no full smoothing/decimation) with top-N component isolation, so the clinician sees the 3D vascular tree form in near-real-time as they move the sliders — like the desktop app.

post.summary: Detect aneurysm candidates in the segmented mesh
post.description:
Runs the v6 aneurysm detector on the stored vessel-tree mesh.

**Algorithm:** Gaussian curvature thresholding → connected-component analysis → 3 hard shape gates (positive_gauss_frac, compactness, sphericity) → composite score.

Each candidate is written as an isolated `.vtp` mesh and its URL is returned so vtk.js can render individual domes.

**Prerequisite:** `POST /segment` must be called first.

get.description:
Runs the full morphometric analysis on the best-scoring candidate mesh from the most recent detection run.

Returns all clinical indices:
- **DNR** (Dome-to-Neck Ratio) — risk ↑ if > 2.0
- **AR** (Aspect Ratio) — risk ↑ if > 1.6
- **BF** (Bottleneck Factor) — wide neck if > 1.5
- **UI** (Undulation Index) — irregular dome if > 0.15
- **EI** (Ellipticity Index) — non-spherical if > 0.35
- **NSI** (Non-Sphericity Index)

Neck origin is saved to session state for the perforators endpoint.

**Prerequisite:** `POST /detect/{session_id}` must be called first.

post.summary: Morphometry from a user-defined neck plane (closed-sac)
post.description:
Semi-automatic Tier-2 morphometry. The user supplies a **neck plane** (a point on the neck and a normal pointing toward the dome). The backend clips the vessel tree at the plane, keeps the dome-side connected component, caps it into a **closed watertight sac**, and measures the neck directly from the clip contour.

Use this when the automatic analysis returns `reliable=false` (the detector isolated an open surface cap, on which volume/neck degenerate).

get.description:
Analyses the full vascular mesh around the aneurysm neck to identify suspected perforator / branch-point candidates based on vertex-valence anomaly detection.

**Risk zones** (centred on neck origin):
- Zone 1 (high / red)   — ≤ 3 mm from neck
- Zone 2 (medium / yellow) — 3–5 mm from neck
- Zone 3 (low / green)  — 5–8 mm from neck

The tagged mesh (`perforators_risk.vtp`) is also written to the session for colour-mapped 3D display.

**Best results:** run `POST /detect` and `GET /morphometry` first so the neck origin is accurate.  Falls back to the first detected candidate's centroid when morphometry has not been run.

get.summary: Get longitudinal follow-up data for this session's patient
get.description:
Returns all historical planning sessions for the patient linked to this session, ordered by date, plus computed deltas against the previous session.

**Prerequisite:** the session must have been saved via `POST /api/sessions/save` with a `patient_id` to enable longitudinal comparison. Without a saved record, returns only the current session's morphometry snapshot.

post.summary: Compute CLIP vs ENDOVASCULAR recommendation
post.description:
Runs the 8-factor evidence-based decision engine using aneurysm morphometry (stored in the session after Step 3 — Detección/Morfometría) and optional clinical inputs (location, rupture status). Returns a scored recommendation with full factor breakdown.

**References:** ISAT 2002, BRAT 2013, AHA/ASA Guidelines 2015.

get.description: Returns the full surgical clip library (40+ models across Yasargil, Sugita, Aesculap and Codman systems). Each entry includes blade length, shape, closing force, and the required applier.

schema.title: Response Get Clip Library Api Clips Get

get.summary: Get clip recommendations from the Clip Recommender assistant
get.description:
Scores all clips in the catalogue against the patient's neck diameter and aspect ratio (loaded from session morphometry). Returns up to 8 ranked recommendations.

Scoring weights: coverage ratio 45%, shape fit 40%, closing force 15%.

schema.title: Response Get Clip Recommendations Api Clips Recommendations  Session Id  Get

post.summary: Upload a custom clip mesh (STL/OBJ)
post.description: Imports a user-supplied clip geometry (STL or OBJ), centres it at the origin and stores it for placement. Returns a `custom:*` clip_id usable in the clip plan alongside catalogue clips.

post.summary: Compute clip placement plan
post.description: Builds a real 3D mesh of each placed clip, checks collision against the segmented vessel with vtkCollisionDetectionFilter, and estimates neck coverage from the intersection of the clips with the neck plane. Returns the combined clip mesh URL (.vtp) for the 3D viewer.

get.description: Returns the full endovascular coil library (40+ models: Stryker Target 360°, Penumbra Ruby, MicroVention HydroCoil, Medtronic Axium). Each entry includes diameter, length, coil type (framing/filling/finishing) and required microwire.

schema.title: Response Get Coil Library Api Coils Get

post.summary: Compute coil embolization plan
post.description:
Accepts a list of coil placements and estimates the resulting packing density based on coil wire volumes and the aneurysm sac volume (from session morphometry). Returns packing density and estimated angiographic occlusion grade.

Target: ≥ 20% packing density for durable occlusion (Sluzewski AJNR 2004).

get.description: Returns all available stent models with their size specifications.

schema.title: Response Get Stent Library Api Stents Get

post.summary: Compute stent deployment plan
post.description: Places the selected stent at the aneurysm neck and computes neck coverage. Returns the deployed stent mesh URL and coverage metrics.

post.summary: Generate surgical PDF report
post.description:
Assembles all session data (morphometry, treatment decision, patient info) and generates a structured PDF using ReportLab.

**Prerequisite:** the session must have completed at least the morphometry step (Step 3) for the report to contain clinical data.

An optional `screenshot_png_b64` field (base64-encoded PNG) can be sent to embed the 3D viewer capture in the report.

Returns a `/data/…` download URL pointing to the generated PDF.

post.summary: Generate a DICOM Structured Report (SR)
post.description:
Builds a DICOM Comprehensive SR (TID 1500) from the session's morphometry and risk assessment — an interoperable, PACS-storable record of the measurements. **Prerequisite:** the morphometry step must be complete.

Returns a `/data/…` download URL pointing to the generated `.dcm` file.

post.summary: Export mesh as STL for 3D printing
post.description:
Merges the selected session meshes (vessel tree and/or aneurysm dome) into a single STL file suitable for 3D printing.

**Prerequisite:** the session must have completed the segmentation step (Step 2) so that `vessel_tree.vtp` exists.

Use `scale_factor` to adjust physical dimensions (1.0 = real size in mm).

Returns a `/data/…` download URL pointing to the generated `.stl` file.

post.summary: Save the surgical approach trajectory
post.description: Persists the entry → target approach corridor in session state so it is included in the PDF report and the DICOM SR. Returns the stored points plus the approach depth and incidence angle.

post.summary: Save current session state to database
post.description: Persists the session's morphometry snapshot and metadata to the database. Subsequent calls update the same record (upsert on session_id). Optionally links the session to a patient and/or study record.

get.description: Returns all planning sessions from the database, newest first.

schema.title: Response List Sessions Api Sessions Get

post.summary: Restore a saved session
post.description: Creates a fresh temporary session and re-populates its state from the database record identified by `session_id`. Returns the new session_id to use for subsequent API calls.

get.summary: Get DICOM volume metadata for MPR
get.description: Loads (and caches) the primary DICOM series volume and returns its shape, spacing and default window/level so the frontend can set up the MPR sliders. First call triggers the volume load; subsequent calls are instant.

schema.title: Response Volume Meta Api Volume  Session Id  Meta Get

get.summary: Get the downsampled volume as raw uint8 for 3D volume rendering
get.description: Returns the DICOM volume as raw uint8 bytes (C-order, z·y·x), downsampled so the largest axis is ≤ 192 and rescaled over a robust intensity window. Dimensions and spacing are returned in the X-Dims / X-Spacing headers. Consumed by the client-side vtk.js volume renderer.

get.summary: Get an oblique (tilted) MPR slice as PNG
get.description: Resamples an oblique plane through the volume centre, tilted by `tilt` degrees around the x- or y-axis, scanned along its normal by `pos` (0–1).

get.summary: Get a single MPR slice as PNG
get.description: Returns a grayscale PNG of the requested plane and slice index, with the given window center/width applied. Planes: axial · coronal · sagital.

post.summary: Compute the PHASES score
post.description:
Computes the PHASES 5-year rupture-risk score for an unruptured aneurysm (Greving et al., Lancet Neurology 2014) from six factors: Population, Hypertension, Age, Size, Earlier SAH and Site. The Size factor is usually filled from the morphometric analysis.

Pass `session_id` to record the score in the planning session — that is what makes it appear in the PDF report and the DICOM SR.

post.summary: Extract the vessel centreline between two points
post.description: Computes the medial-axis centreline of the segmented vessel between a source and a target point (voxelisation + EDT + Dijkstra on the distance-weighted grid). Returns a tube mesh of varying radius plus clinical metrics: arc length, tortuosity and vessel diameter statistics.

post.summary: Analyse vessel cross-sections along the centreline
post.description: Cuts the vessel with planes perpendicular to the extracted centreline and measures the cross-sectional area (shoelace) at each, yielding a diameter profile and a stenosis estimate. Requires that the centreline was extracted first (POST /api/centerline/{session_id}).

post.summary: Deploy a stent along the vessel centreline
post.description: Sweeps a stent tube along the previously-extracted centreline between two arc-length positions (parallel-transport frames + optional helical braids), following the true vessel curvature — unlike the straight neck stent. Requires that the centreline was extracted first (POST /api/centerline/{session_id}).

post.summary: Append an event to the audit chain

schema.title: Response Append Event Api Audit Post

get.description: Returns every block of the tamper-evident SkullChain audit trail, oldest first.

schema.title: Response List Blocks Api Audit Blocks Get

get.summary: Verify the integrity of the audit chain
get.description: Recomputes every block hash and checks the prev-hash linkage. Any tampering with a block invalidates it and all following blocks.

get.summary: Export the audit trail as text

post.summary: Crop the vessel mesh to a box/sphere ROI
post.description: Non-destructive ROI crop of the working vessel mesh. `mode='sphere'` keeps geometry within `radius` of the picked centre; `mode='box'` uses an axis-aligned box (`half_size` per axis, or `radius` as a cube half-side). `invert=true` removes the ROI instead (useful to delete a bone/noise blob). The result overwrites `vessel_tree.vtp`; re-run segmentation to restore.

post.summary: Grow a vessel mesh from seed points
post.description: Region-growing segmentation (SimpleITK ConnectedThreshold) starting from one or more seed points placed on the volume, expanding through connected voxels within [lower, upper] HU. Builds a fresh `vessel_tree.vtp` — an alternative to threshold segmentation for cases where a global threshold leaks into bone. Requires that a DICOM volume has been uploaded.

schema.title: Response List Beds Api Print Prep Beds Get

post.summary: Prepare the vessel mesh for 3D printing
post.description: Fill holes → smooth → optional subdivision → scale to a target size, then report physical dimensions, solid volume, watertightness (open-edge count) and whether it fits the requested printer bed. Writes a print-ready STL. Requires that segmentation produced `vessel_tree.vtp`.

post.summary: Preprocess the session volume (clip / isotropic resample / smooth)
post.description: Applies optional HU clipping, isotropic resampling and Gaussian smoothing to the cached volume and rewrites the MPR cache. The segmentation and any downstream analysis must be re-run afterwards. Requires an uploaded volume.

ei.description: Ellipticity Index  (> 0.35 → non-spherical, higher rupture risk)

sr.title: Sr
sr.description: Size Ratio = max_diameter / parent_artery_diameter. 0 when parent artery not available (> 3.0 → elevated risk)

rupture_risk_label.title: Rupture Risk Label
rupture_risk_label.description: Heuristic rupture-risk label derived from AR, DNR, UI, SR. NOT a clinical diagnosis — for planning reference only.

reliable.title: Reliable
reliable.description: True when the analysis ran on a closed, physically plausible sac. False when the mesh was an open surface patch (detector cap): volume, neck and all derived ratios are then nulled — place a neck plane (POST .../neck-plane) to obtain a valid closed-sac measurement.

neck_source.title: Neck Source
neck_source.description: 'auto' = neck from automatic plane-slicing on the candidate; 'manual' = neck from a user-defined neck plane (closed-sac isolation).

neck_valid.title: Neck Valid
neck_valid.description: False when automatic neck detection failed (neck_mm < 1 mm or PCA axis mismatch on complex DSA meshes). DNR, AR, BF and rupture_risk_label are unreliable when False.

warning.title: Warning
warning.description: Human-readable warning shown in the UI when neck_valid is False or when indices fall outside clinically plausible ranges.

centroid.description: Centre of mass of the aneurysm mesh in patient space (mm)

principal_axis.title: Principal Axis
principal_axis.description: Principal PCA axis as [x, y, z] unit vector

neck_origin.description: Centre of the aneurysm neck in patient space (mm). This is the point a clip or stent must be placed on — do not re-derive it from the centroid and the dome height, which lands off the neck.

MorphometryResult.title: MorphometryResult
MorphometryResult.description:
Full quantitative morphometry of the selected aneurysm.

Matches MorphometricResult from prospective/processing/morphometrics.py.
All linear values in mm; ratios are dimensionless.

origin.description: A point on the neck plane (mm, patient space)

normal.title: Normal
normal.description: Plane normal [x, y, z] pointing toward the dome (need not be unit length)

dome_seed.description: Optional point inside the dome to disambiguate the sac side. Defaults to origin + 3·normal.

NeckPlaneRequest.title: NeckPlaneRequest
NeckPlaneRequest.description:
User-defined neck plane for semi-automatic closed-sac morphometry.

The user places a point on the neck and a normal pointing toward the dome.
The backend clips the vessel tree at this plane, keeps the dome-side
connected component, caps the opening into a closed watertight sac, and
measures the neck directly from the plane∩tree contour.
